label: Contact
seo_description: Reach RunMyCampus for sales, implementation planning, partnerships, or general questions. Support for existing schools is routed through your tenant portal.
headline: Let's connect your school or network to one operating platform.
subheadline: Tell us whether you are exploring procurement, planning rollout, need partner information, or want a general orientation—we'll route your message appropriately.

contact_intent_cards.title: Sales inquiry
contact_intent_cards.body: Evaluate fit, packaging, and roadmap for your leadership team.

contact_intent_cards.title: Implementation inquiry
contact_intent_cards.body: Discuss phases, integrations, and success criteria before go-live.

contact_intent_cards.title: Support
contact_intent_cards.body: Operational help for schools already on the platform.

contact_intent_cards.title: General

extras.contact_support_note: We aim to respond to inbound requests within one business day. Existing customers should use in-product support channels for fastest resolution.
extras.contact_implementation_note: Implementation conversations cover data expectations, rollout waves, training, and governance—without committing you to a purchase timeline.
